_about: The 'Why you'll love <villa>' box under each villa's photos. It is filled automatically from the villa's data (bedrooms, views, nearest beach, stand-out amenities). To write it yourself for one villa, add the villa's page name (the part after /villa/ in its address) with up to 6 short lines, e.g. "can-josie": ["Sea views", "Near Cala Jondal", "Private tennis court"]. Remove the villa to go back to the automatic list.
